name: Beefy Vault V7 + StrategyERC4626
description: Beefy yield vault (BeefyVaultV7) whose strategy (StrategyERC4626) deploys the vault's want token into an external ERC-4626 vault. Snapshot of beefy-contracts pinned to a fixed commit; the external ERC-4626 vault, swapper, fee config, factory and Merkl claimer are outside the analysed scope.

instances.label: BeefyVaultV7
instances.description: User-facing vault; issues the vault share token (mooToken).

instances.label: StrategyERC4626
instances.description: Strategy attached to the vault; deposits want into an external ERC-4626 vault.

bindings.note: Deployment wires the vault to this strategy via initialize(_strategy, ...).
Deployment wires the strategy back to the vault via initialize(..., Addresses{vault: ...}).

assets.label: mooToken (vault share)
assets.description: ERC-20 share token implemented by BeefyVaultV7 itself.

assets.label: want
assets.description: Token stored in StrategyERC4626.want; the vault reads it through strategy.want().

assets.label: ERC-4626 share
assets.description: Shares of the external ERC-4626 vault stored in StrategyERC4626.erc4626.

notes: Only BeefyVaultV7.sol, StrategyERC4626.sol and their transitive imports are part of the snapshot.
No deployment addresses are configured: assets and external contracts are identified by scoped expressions.
